skill.name: cold-email
skill.description: Draft B2B cold emails, follow-up sequences, and LinkedIn messages with guidance on deliverability, coordinated outreach, and reply handling.
skill.summary: Create relevant outbound messages and plan follow-ups, sending safeguards, and reply workflows.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All 18 static findings are false positives involving writing examples, Markdown formatting, or GitHub documentation links. One semantic risk concerns recommendations that reduce detection of prohibited LinkedIn automation, exposing users to account restrictions. No evidence found of credential theft, executable payloads, unauthorized data exfiltration, or audit-directed prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The LinkedIn guide recommends randomized timing and residential IPs for automation that it acknowledges violates platform rules.
remediation.suggestion: Remove detection-evasion recommendations and prohibited automation options; recommend manual outreach, human task queues, or explicitly authorized platform integrations.

semantic_findings.title: Detection-evasion guidance for prohibited LinkedIn automation
semantic_findings.description: The guide acknowledges that third-party LinkedIn automation violates platform rules, then recommends high-volume automation on expendable profiles. It advises "randomized timing" and "dedicated residential IPs per account," reducing detection signals and risking account restrictions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide explicitly identifies the platform violation and recommends measures addressing the detection signals described earlier. This is unsafe operational guidance, not evidence of malware.

content.user_title: Write Relevant B2B Cold Emails and Follow-Ups
content.value_statement: Generic outbound messages struggle to earn relevant replies. This skill helps draft focused emails, plan follow-ups, and define sending safeguards and reply workflows.
actual_capabilities: Draft concise cold emails using observation, problem, proof, and a single low-friction question.
Suggest short subject lines and adjust message tone for executives, managers, and technical audiences.
Create follow-up sequences with timing, different angles, and a final message that ends outreach.
Provide sending-setup checklists covering authentication, list verification, tracking, opt-outs, and monitoring.
Plan coordinated email, LinkedIn, and phone cadences with shared reply and suppression rules.
Classify replies and draft responses with human review boundaries for agents.
limitations: The package provides instructions and references, not a standalone sending service or installed tool integrations.
Prospect-list building, detailed research, and lifecycle campaigns are delegated to related skills.
Performance benchmarks and provider limits require independent verification and do not guarantee replies or inbox placement.
Some LinkedIn automation guidance violates platform rules and risks account restrictions.

use_cases.title: Prepare founder outreach
use_cases.description: Turn a specific customer problem and verified proof into a short email with one clear question.

use_cases.title: Improve follow-up sequences
use_cases.description: Rewrite repetitive follow-ups into distinct messages with clear spacing and reply-based stopping rules.

use_cases.title: Define outbound operating rules
use_cases.description: Create sending-readiness checks and reply-routing plans before configuring external campaign tools.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first email
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a cold email to [role] about [problem]. Our offer is [offer], and our verified proof is [proof]. Ask one simple question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a first draft from known facts.

prompt_templates.title: Review an existing message
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this cold email: [email]. Identify weak relevance, filler, unsupported claims, and excessive asks. Rewrite it and suggest three short subject lines.

prompt_templates.title: Build a follow-up sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build four total emails for [audience] using [offer] and [verified evidence]. Add timing and different angles. Stop after any reply or opt-out.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: plan a complete email sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Design a reviewed outbound workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email and manual LinkedIn outreach for [segment]. Include authentication checks, shared suppression, reply classification, human approvals, and stop thresholds. Do not send messages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare an operational plan for external tools.

output_examples.input: Draft an email to a finance leader hiring expense reviewers. Our tool routes approvals; no customer results are available.
output: Your reviewer openings suggest expense approvals need more capacity. Our tool routes each report to the right approver. Would a short workflow example be useful?
If this is not relevant, reply no and I will stop.

output_examples.input: A prospect asks about pricing on LinkedIn while our email sequence continues. What should happen?
output: Pause every outreach sequence for this contact.
Classify the reply as an information request and notify the responsible representative.
Draft an answer using approved pricing, with human review before sending.
Log the channel, reply type, sequence step, and outcome in the CRM.

best_practices: Supply verified prospect observations, a clear offer, and approved proof before drafting.
Check authentication, list quality, opt-out handling, and current provider rules before configuring sends.
Use manual LinkedIn outreach and pause all channels when a prospect replies or opts out.
anti_patterns: Inventing prospect research, customer results, or personal familiarity to make messages seem relevant.
Continuing automated follow-ups after a reply, opt-out, or promised final message.
Using prohibited LinkedIn automation or detection-evasion settings to increase outreach volume.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the skill send emails automatically?
faq.answer: The package contains guidance and documentation links. Actual sending requires separately configured tools, credentials, and authorization.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target role, relevant observation, offer, desired outcome, and verified proof. The skill can identify missing context.

faq.question: Can it build prospect lists or nurture campaigns?
faq.answer: It directs list building and account research to prospecting, and lifecycle campaigns to the emails skill.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better reply rates?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on targeting, offer, data quality, sender reputation, and execution. Treat quoted benchmarks as context, not promises.

faq.question: Is LinkedIn automation risk-free?
faq.answer: No. The guide acknowledges platform-rule violations and account restrictions. Prefer manual outreach or human task queues over its detection-evasion recommendations.
